name: Tom-Erik Jensen
quote:
DOF highly values its partnership with DIPAI, recognizing their strong service-minded and
          quality-focused culture, as well as their flexibility and commitment to continuous
          improvement. DIPAI consistently adapts to evolving needs and proactively enhances both
          existing solutions and future requirements.

name: Svein Erik Isaksen
quote:
Dipai delivers high-quality insights and follow-up. The team is solution-oriented, quick
          to respond, and highly professional. It gives us great confidence to work with a partner
          that truly understands the maritime industry.

name: Stian S. Waage
quote:
Our experience working with Dipai has been positive, and we quickly recognised the value
          of the platform. By providing access to operational data, the platform enables a
          data-driven approach to analyse our vessels operations, help to identify trends, improve
          energy efficiency, and support continuous improvement across our fleet. As a common source
          of operational insight, Dipai supports our digital transformation and will assist to
          identify further actions under our sustainability plan.

name: Sveinung Økland
quote:
We are pleased to partner with Dipai and look forward to a strong and productive
          collaboration. Access to high-quality vessel data and advanced analytics will support our
          ambition to continuously improve operational performance, efficiency, and decision-making
          across our fleet.

name: Torbjørn Ingeborgvik
quote:
Dipai has proven to be a competent and solution-oriented partner. The implementation has
          progressed quickly, their support has been responsive, and we are already seeing value
          from the insights they provide. We have high expectations for the value this collaboration
          can create going forward.
